text: SELECT o.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_drink_item = 1 THEN oi.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS beverage_revenue FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items AS oi JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE LOWER(c.customer_name) = LOWER('Ryan byrd') GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.customer_name
